verdict.rationale: Instinct's own site says users can 'text or call it' and that it may proactively call them, and the privacy policy mentions optional audio/voice data collection, so a voice channel with the assistant is documented. The community 'calls' evidence describes Instinct phoning third parties such as restaurants, not users talking with it, so the natural, real-time quality of user-to-assistant voice conversation is unproven. Missing for 10: any description of conversational voice quality or latency, hands-on reports of users calling the assistant, and detail on voice features beyond a one-line mention.
